articles.title: A Lost Mega-Cliff May Solve the Grand Canyon's Billion-Year Mystery
articles.summary: A colossal escarpment, formed when the supercontinent Rodinia split 800 million years ago, may have eroded away up to 8 km of rock, exposing the Grand Canyon's ancient basement. This could explain the Great Unconformity—a billion-year gap in the rock record.

articles.title: Could Dark Stars Be the Missing Link to Supermassive Black Holes?
articles.summary: A new theory proposes that hypothetical 'dark stars,' powered by dark matter annihilation, collapsed into massive black hole seeds in the early universe. Their mergers could explain the low-frequency gravitational wave hum detected by pulsar timing arrays.

articles.title: AI as Math Tutor: Helpful Tool or Harmful Crutch?
articles.summary: A survey of 1,300 high-achieving math students reveals that AI can be beneficial when used to explain concepts and check work, but harmful if it replaces struggle. Teachers warn that overreliance on AI leads to poor test performance.
